# Human-Agent Process

> A process for humans and AI agents working together: risk tiers, a start gate with a `hap_gate:` marker, independent critic and QA roles, and evidence-based done. One shared core, distributed as a Claude Code plugin and a Codex plugin with agents and an AGENTS.md block.

## Start

- [README](README.md): what it is, quickstart for both platforms, modules
- [Install for agents](docs/start/install-for-agents.md): exact steps and the verification (`hap_gate:` line)
- [Quickstart](docs/start/quickstart.md): five minutes
